address: Mandarin Oriental Hotel, Level 5, Marina Square, 5 Raffles Avenue, 039797, Singapore
bio: Overlooking a lush garden, the spacious interior adroitly juggles modern sensibility with stylised Chinese motifs. Supervised by celebrated chef Fei, the kitchen excels in traditional Cantonese, with a subtle Chaoshan touch and an emphasis on seafood. The must-try stir-fried Xisha Island lobster with garlic soy sauce boasts bouncy flesh and briny sweetness. Creamy and umami-rich, boneless crucian carp congee demonstrates exquisite knife work.
